coordination.reason: Concurrent BASE ClayCode parser workers were active; this work touches new UnifiedDB runtime/test/benchmark/workflow paths and does not overwrite their critical-path files.

hypothesis: During an explicitly read-free interval, safe complete Pulse notifications can be composed into one final-state projection delta and one coherent SPM generation without changing the final projection state, reducing complete generation-map publication amplification and redundant seed recomputation.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Intermediate observers, temporal consumers, non-composable transitions, incomplete impact closure or epoch discontinuity require every Pulse to remain individually observable; batching across such boundaries would be semantically wrong and must fail back to sequential publication.

existing_baseline.relevant_property: Each coherent SPM-S1 Pulse publishes a complete generation->seed->immutable-segment map even when only a bounded seed subset is recomputed.

semantic_guards: raw authoritative events remain preserved outside the effectivizer
source and graph epochs must be contiguous
per-logical-id before/after fingerprint lineage must compose exactly
net-zero chains may cancel only inside the final-state projection work plan
impact seeds are unioned only for remaining effective changes
authority remains projection-preprocessor-only with no truth/GWT/model/tool/effect authority

covered: chain composition and exact net-zero cancellation
fully cancelled batch exposes metadata-only epoch gap

limitations: proxy includes complete generation-map publication plus deterministic seed recomputation rather than the entire SPM-S1 schema/runtime
real Frank Pulse distributions are unmeasured
downstream Frank outcome quality is unmeasured

Demonstrates constrained changeset coalescing/net-effect semantics; does not prove Clay semantic safety.

newly_exposed_gap.name: SPM_S1_METADATA_ONLY_EPOCH_ADVANCE
newly_exposed_gap.description: A fully net-cancelled read-free batch still spans authoritative epochs, but SPM-S1 currently rejects a Pulse with no changed logical ids. S2 therefore refuses adaptation rather than inventing a fake change.

architecture_delta.change: Insert an optional bounded final-state Pulse effectivizer before SPM-S1 projection maintenance only across proven read-free semantic intervals; retain raw event history and publish one coherent final-state generation at the observation boundary.
architecture_delta.rollback: Disable S2 and process every Pulse sequentially through existing SPM-S1.
